value: Free in a floor hatch inside the Derelict Spy Vessel wreck at the southern tip of the southeastern Permit Keys island, east of Mile Zero Air Station. Reachable in Chapter 1; use Focus (L3+R3) to reveal the hatch, open it (Triangle/Y) and take the pistol. Also a WAiNK Curiosity - scan the wreck with the phone app.
locator: Beebom secret silenced pistol guide: Derelict Spy Vessel shipwreck, southern tip of the long central Permit Keys island; pry open the floor hatch and claim the silenced pistol, free in Chapter 1. Corroborated by Dexerto, esports.gg, RetroBroker, KeenGamer, ShowGamer, libertycity and ezg - all agree on the wreck, the hatch and the Mile Zero Air Station landmark.

value: In the trunk of Donnie's rusty red '85 Dinka Blista during the Chapter 1 mission 'Don Gone' (Key Lento). Open the rear hatch and take the revolver before destroying the car - permanently missable if the car is destroyed first. A second window remains if you drive off and pull over before disposing of it.
locator: RetroBroker Donnie's H&L .38 guide: two pickup windows (at the trailer after the driveway ambush, or pulled over before disposal); press L1/LB on the DONNIE'S H&L.38 REVOLVER prompt. Corroborated by KeenGamer, ScreenRant, ShowGamer, thegameswiki (Don Gone page), Nerdschalk, Exputer and OfZenAndComputing - all agree on the Blista trunk, the Don Gone mission and the permanently-missable warning.

value: In a weapon case on the illuminated pool table in the northeast corner of Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn, during the Chapter 2 Illegal Operation 'Hit Kingpin Bowling' (unlocks after 'Coffee Break'). One of three Key Valuables for the Let's Go Bowling trophy, alongside the Crowex Octane 'Orca' luxury watch and the office safe (code 0300).
locator: Dexerto wiki: on the pool table in the north-east corner of the Kingpin Bowling alley, Port Gellhorn, during the Kingpin Bowling job; 8-round pump-action, 12-gauge. Corroborated by ScreenRant, ShowGamer (x2), Mobalytics, thegameswiki, alcasthq, gta.guide and RetroBroker - all agree on the pool-table case, the Port Gellhorn bowling alley and the Chapter 2 unlock.

value: Leaning on the wooden crates at the back-left of the main hangar in the IAA Black Site bunker, Big Pine, North Mariana County. Enter via the ground hatch (green keypad on a pine tree, code 085355), restore power, open the hangar from the control room; the same hangar holds the free Hauners Ridgway tank.
locator: RetroBroker Cold War 556 guide: pine-tree keypad 085355 opens the hatch; the Duke Arms Cold War 556 leans on crates against the back-left wall of the hangar, with free ammunition, grenades and sticky bombs. Corroborated by GamesFuze, Detonated, thegameswiki, KeenGamer, gta6-life, KhelNow, Exputer and Sportskeeda - all agree on Big Pine, 085355 and the hangar crates.

value: In the seat of a crashed paramotor caught in a tree at Bobcat Bight, Capri Island, Mariana County. Shoot the lines holding the wreckage, let it fall to the ground, then collect the pistol from the seat. No combat or mission required.
locator: KeenGamer best early-game unique weapons: Turnt Nipper .38 hidden in the wreckage of a paramotor caught in a tree at Bobcat Bight, Capri Island; shoot the lines and search the fallen paramotor. Corroborated by Insider Gaming, ShowGamer (x2), Dexerto, games.gg, Sportskeeda, gta.guide, Exputer, thegameswiki and libertycity - all agree on Bobcat Bight, the tree-caught paramotor and shooting the lines.
GTA BOOM Capri Corrupt Cops walkthrough (hands-on): getting arrested is how you get the CPD Moreland 850 shotgun; take the shotgun from the trunk before freeing the two remaining prisoners.
GTA BOOM walkthrough title and body name the reward 'CPD Moreland 850' throughout; VGC and GameRant use the same name.

value: In the open trunk of the corrupt officers' police car at their holding facility, reached by getting arrested in Capri (Beacon Circle pavilion) and breaking out of the cage; reclaim your confiscated gear and take the shotgun from the trunk. Unique and kept on pickup.
locator: VGC Capri secret mission guide: surrender to the Capri police instead of the Busted screen, escape the cage at the holding facility, then check the boot of the police vehicle outside for your confiscated equipment and the CPD Moreland 850 shotgun. Corroborated by GTA BOOM (hands-on) and GameRant - all agree on the arrest trigger, the cage breakout and the trunk pickup.

LeonidaHub: 'a unique SMG (the DW-9 with furry art)' - the Furry DW-9. Corroborated by GameSpot ('the unique Furry DW-9 submachine gun'), GTAVIInsider ('Furry DW-9 SMG') and GTAScoop ('a custom SMG').

value: Random night encounter 'No Paws Clause' after Chapter 3: on Miramar Drive, Crosstown, Vice City, at night (guides report 9 PM-4 AM, most commonly midnight-4 AM), police have cornered Chase, a man in a fox suit. Offer him a ride, lose the 3-star wanted level at the parking garage, drive the Furverts to their Starfish Island hideout, then choose the Furry DW-9 SMG or a cash reward. One-time: if you drive past, police kill Chase and the encounter is lost.
locator: GameSpot: Miramar Drive, Crosstown, midnight-4 AM, after Chapter 3; lift Chase, 3-star wanted level, parking garage, Starfish Island, choose the Furry DW-9 or cash. LeonidaHub (9 PM-4 AM window; Gfinity: driving past loses the encounter) + GTAVIInsider ('No Paws Clause') + GameTrek + GTAScoop corroborate. Cash figure NOT claimed: $15,000 (GameSpot) vs $12,500 (most other guides).

value: Enter the shed/shack north of Leonida State Prison, side door, hatch and generator wire down into a mining tunnel; the pistol is on a dead convict's body at the end, with an 'Anthony's Auto Repair' business card carrying code 120113. Built-in flashlight.
locator: Game8 full route; 5+ gameplay reels show the same path (e.g. YouTube short HkHdwdmEpIo). County wording differs between sources (Game8: Gellhorn; earlier notes: Kelly County) — no county claimed.

value: Detached garage behind a run-down house just west of Ambrosia (Frogwater area, Kelly County); keypad code 120113 — the same code found on the card with the Convict Kalinga .50; alarmed, no tracker; plate S33 Y4 (Talladega Nights reference).
locator: GamerHour, ViceCityDB, gta6gps and Gameta list the garage and code 120113; reels tie it to the pistol via the S33 Y4 plate.

value: Hog Stars Garage, northern Ambrosia — rescue the captured Final Chapter enforcer from the barn, then clear the gang's car wash/clubhouse; the car is parked in the garage. Enter via the roof skylight; guard dogs inside. The Final Chapter Shortstraw Shotgun is on a table in the same room.
locator: Sportskeeda + Insider Gaming + GameRant agree on Hog Stars Garage; LeonidaHub corroborates the $8,500 register figure.

Sportskeeda: 'claim the vehicle for $8,500'; Insider Gaming table agrees ($8,500 register, $21,890 sell value). Sell value carried here, not as a separate claim: $21,890 (Sportskeeda + Insider Gaming).

value: Chatfield Storage & Logistics yard, Waxman Island — inside a ground-level shipping container. No tracker and no alarm; the yard office upstairs holds the Quarter Mile ES9 pistol and a safe (code 5800).

value: Final Chapter compound (Irons Building Supply), Birch Street, Ambrosia, Kelly County — the orange bike on the ground floor of the central garage/warehouse. Moses' sixth vehicle request; $6,310 base payout on delivery to Port Gellhorn.
locator: KeenGamer 'All 7 Moses Vehicle Drop-Off Locations': 'Western Nightblade | Birch St, Ambrosia | Final Chapter clubhouse' — 'the orange motorcycle at the back of the ground floor' of the central warehouse; open the compound gate before riding out. Corroborated by Destructoid (motorcycle club on Birch St, Kelly County; ladder/roof route into the compound), thegameswiki Motorcycle Clubs (Irons Building Supply holds 'a club-owned Western Nightblade motorcycle that Moses asks you to steal'), magicgameworld, heistatlas, playermanual, finalboss and gta6info, plus the no-commentary playthrough (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=URJ8TKAmoYI) showing the same compound, bike and a $6,330 delivered payout (condition bonus over the $6,310 base).

value: Crimson Palms Condominiums parking area, Washington Beach, Vice Beach — the gold Tempesta is parked in the condo parking (take the ramp on the right from the main gate). A second reported spot is outside the Cirque de Cuisine restaurant in Ocean Beach. Key Cloner (Chapter 3) required to steal.
locator: KeenGamer: 'The golden Huracan is known as the Pegassi Gold Rush Tempesta. You can find this supercar at Crimson Palms Condominiums in Washington Beach or outside the Cirque de Cuisine restaurant in Ocean Beach.' Corroborated by Sportskeeda ('tall high-rise complex named Crimson Palms... take the ramp on your right to the parking area') and Beebom (same two spots). KeenGamer: 'You’ll need to unlock the Key Cloner during Chapter 3 before you can steal either vehicle.'

value: Nova Auto Junkyard (M7 gang Illegal Operation), northeast Hamlet, Vice-Dale County — golden rifle on a workbench under the metal awning beside the large blue shipping container, northern section of the yard. The office safe in the southeast building opens with code 7777; the Albany Teniente Manana is in the adjoining garage.
locator: RadarLeonida (27 Nov 2026, Anubis_RD footage): golden Marabunta Grande KZ-59 at the Hamlet scrapyard, Teniente Manana in the workshop garage. Corroborated by ShowGamer Nova Auto Junkyard guide (rifle on the workbench beside the large blue container under the metal awning, northern section; safe code 7777; Teniente in the garage), Heistbook ('Table under central canopy at Nova Auto Junkyard'), thegameswiki Nova Auto Junkyard page, Insider Gaming illegal-operations table (Nova Auto Junkyard, Hamlet - KZ-59 + Teniente Manana), GameRant M7 Compound guide and LibertyCity. Note: RadarLeonida words the rifle as 'inside the blue container'; the majority of sources place it on the workbench beside the container, which is what this claim states.
